name: ar4ds-housing-workspace (R + Quarto)
postCreateCommand: Rscript -e "os <- readLines('/etc/os-release'); codename <- sub('VERSION_CODENAME=', '', grep('^VERSION_CODENAME=', os, value = TRUE)); options(repos = c(CRAN = sprintf('https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/__linux__/%s/2026-11-17', codename))); install.packages('pak'); pak::pak(c('dplyr','purrr','readr','tibble','datawizard','parameters','sandwich','marginaleffects','effectsize','tinyplot','tinytable','dagitty','rmarkdown'))"
